question_text: For each student in the MIT student directory whose department is '6' (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science) and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their full name, email address, department name, the corresponding SIS admin department name, the average department code within each department code group, the department name from the degree-granting departments (excluding Mathematics), and the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes for all degree-granting courses in that department.
